name: Cybonet Information Technology
summary: Sydney dialup/web-hosting ISP; sold internet operations to Internet Depot Feb 2001, continued as IT company.

events.details: Cybonet Information Technology Pty Ltd established Jul 1999; became an ISP Oct 1999 providing dialup internet access in the Sydney region; also web hosting, web design, networking and IT sales.
Sold its internet operations to Internet Depot (Feb 2001); continued as an IT company (Mount Druitt Village NSW).
